name: linkleads
description: LinkLeads — app desktop de prospecção B2B com automação de ritmo humano, multi-conta e CRM local.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/db packages/ai packages/integrations && npm run typecheck -w @linkleads/desktop
scripts.e2e: npm run build && for t in run sequence decision integrations team diagnostics; do xvfb-run -a node apps/desktop/e2e/$t.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @linkleads/desktop
scripts.server: npm run build -w @linkleads/server && node apps/server/dist/cli.js serve
